Genuine C engine versus Rust engine, same synthetic test run (TELE1, a teleporter)
snapshots compared: 174 (the loaded level, then tics 1 to 173)
every state byte equal on every tic: yes
C side: the original DOOM 1.10 code, built and run here; its dumps are encoded by an independent program.
Rust side: the Rust engine, wire 24 (--policy episode1v2). Test map and script: committed, synthetic.
